entries.title: Opal landing + boneyard + memory system
entries.summary: Built 72-landing-opal.html (animated warm-opal 'colour film' background, shimmer headlines, red-carpet velvet-rope accent, responsive, wired signup). Stood up the boneyard salvage system (relics + reusable parts + index.json rolo). Added CLAUDE.md pointer and a docs/ claude.ai Project bundle. Opened PR #1 and backlog issues #2-#6. Established working principles: secrets out of repo, killed builds to boneyard with code, scan the rolo before building UI, data != tool, capture essence not transcripts.
